title: Lucas Cavalcanti & Edward Wible - Exploring four hidden superpowers of Datomic
summary: A Clojure/conj 2014 talk by Lucas Cavalcanti and Edward Wible on four uses of Datomic. They cover HTTP caching, audit trails, mobile database sync and authorization, drawing on the immutable transaction log.
why: HN cites it as Nubank's account of building a bank on Datomic and Clojure, and for what Datomic's temporal model enables.

quote.text: It's worthwhile watching Nubank's talk on how they manage these things with Datomic on the backend
